import sys

MOD = 998244353
INV2 = (MOD + 1) // 2

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, m, l, r = map(int, data[:4])
    k = r - l
    even = k // 2 + 1
    odd = (k + 1) // 2
    cells = n * m
    if cells % 2 == 1:
        print(pow(k + 1, cells, MOD), end='')
    else:
        a = pow(even + odd, cells, MOD)
        b = pow(even - odd, cells, MOD)
        ans = ((a + b) % MOD) * INV2 % MOD
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
